name: ArtifactReadTool
description: 按 artifactUri 读取已经落地的 artifact 资源；JSON 默认分页返回已发布结构索引，并通过 typed query 执行完整元素投影。

artifactUris.description: One or more canonical artifact memory URIs, for example senera://artifact/art_1234567890abcdef12345678.

refs.description: Memory refs to load. Omit to read the projection ref only.

maxBytesPerRef.description: Per-ref byte budget, capped by the configured artifact text-file limit.

startBytePerRef.description: UTF-8 byte offset applied to each requested ref.

refRanges.description: Per-ref byte ranges for independent continuation reads.

sourcePath.description: Object keys leading to the value to index. Use an empty array for the root value.
Object keys leading to the array to stream. Use an empty array for a root array.

select.description: Fields to retain from each matching object.

where.description: Deterministic predicates applied to streamed array items.

jsonView.description: Typed JSON view: index discovers structure; query streams complete array items.

sources.Title: Artifact
sources.Description: Persisted artifact content and evidence available to the current agent.

search.Summary: 按 artifactUri 读取 artifact 资源；JSON 使用已发布结构索引、受控查询、字段投影和游标分页。

Capabilities.Title: Artifact resource read
Capabilities.Description: Load persisted artifact projections or evidence records by canonical artifact URI.

UseCases: 历史工具结果、网页搜索结果、artifact projection、evidence 结构索引和大型 JSON 字段投影。
Avoid: artifactUri 缺失时先使用当前上下文或检索工具定位证据引用。
只需要轻量 facts 就能回答时不要读取完整 artifact。
JSON 首次读取使用 jsonView.kind=index；根据索引中的数组字段改用 jsonView.kind=query、sourcePath 和 select。两类 nextCursor 只能回传给相同 kind，不要使用 rawBlob 猜测结构边界。

Projection.SummaryTemplate:
{% for e in evidence %}- evidenceUri: {{ e.evidenceUri }} {{ e.slots.status }} {{ e.slots.artifactUri }} (loaded={{ e.slots.memoryCount }} unavailable={{ e.slots.unavailableRefCount }} failed={{ e.slots.failedRefCount }})
{% endfor %}

Summary.Template:
{% for block in projections %}{{ block.summary }}
{% endfor %}
